absolute-power-reading-order.text: Amanda Waller executes a global campaign to eliminate all metahumans. Aligning with Failsafe and the Brainiac Queen, she forms the "Trinity of Evil" to neutralize superpowered beings and restore human dominance.

absolute-universe-reading-order.text: The Absolute Universe is a fractured reality born from the fallout of recent multiversal upheavals, where familiar heroes and histories exist in harsher, more extreme forms. In this world, power is unchecked, alliances are unstable, and hope is harder to find. It shares many similarities to the regular DC Universe, but instead of having hope and justice at its core, as embodied by Superman, it is built from despair as embodied by Darkseid.

amazons-attack-reading-order.text: After leaving the Earth, the Amazons return to attack Washington, D.C. in retaliation for the government’s detention of Wonder Woman. Led by Hippolyta and her adviser Circe, the Amazons are joined by mythical creatures such as chimeras, winged horses, hydras, and several cyclopes.

aquaman-death-of-a-prince-reading-order.text: As Aquaman faces his greatest foes, Black Manta plans his ultimate revenge on the Sea King, resulting in the death of Aquaman’s infant son and the dissolution of his marriage.

armageddon-2001-reading-order.text: Armageddon 2001 refers to a gigantic battle between all of Earth’s heroes and a villain known only as Monarch, in which the superheroes were slain and the all-powerful Monarch plunged the world into a totalitarian government underneath his rule.

batman-a-lonely-place-of-dying-reading-o.text: Traumatized by the death of Jason Todd, Batman begins a brutal quest for retribution. Deducing the connection between Bruce Wayne and Batman as well as the repercussions that the murder are having on him, Tim Drake seeks out Dick Grayson in a desperate attempt to reunite the Dynamic Duo.

batman-cataclysm-reading-order.text: Gotham City is unexpectedly hit with a massive earthquake, and nobody is prepared. Wayne Manor collapses with Alfred inside. Batman is in the Batcave which collapses on top of him, leaving him trapped underground. The city is broken and burning.

batman-contagion-reading-order.text: Batman receives a video tape from Azrael warning him that the Order of St. Dumas is sending a plague to Gotham City. Batman discovers that it’s a deadly strand of Ebola called the “The Clench”, which kills the infected in 12 hours.

batman-endgame-reading-order.text: An attack by the other members of the Justice League hints at the return of an old foe.

batman-face-the-face-reading-order.text: Batman and Robin return to Gotham City a year following the events of Infinite Crisis. Batman, in his absence, entrusted the safety of Gotham City to former district attorney Harvey Dent, better known as Two-Face, who has undergone plastic surgery and overcome his split personality.

batman-judgment-on-gotham-reading-order.text: Azrael sees Gotham City as the modern day Sodom and Gomorrah, and the only way to purify the city from it’s sins is to destroy it. Standing in Azrael’s way is Batman, Catwoman, and Red Robin.

batman-legacy-reading-order.text: A new strand of the Apocalypse Virus emerges, this time controlled by Ra’s al Ghul. The Bat Family travel the world as they race to stop The League of Assassins from releasing the pure strain of the virus across the globe.

batman-no-mans-land-reading-order.text: Gotham City has suffered a massive earthquake. The United States government has declared it a No Man’s Land, which effectively quarantines the entire island city. Bridges are destroyed, and any other means of entering or leaving are guarded by the U.S. Army.

batman-officer-down-reading-order.text: Commissioner Gordon is shot by an unknown assailant, and the Batman Family must investigate the attempted murder while their longtime friend in the police department is in a coma.

batman-prodigal-reading-order.text: After the events of the Knightfall Saga Bruce Wayne passes the mantle of Batman to Dick Grayson temporarily so he can re-evaluate what it will take to restore his aura of invincibility.

batman-requiem-reading-order.text: Following the death of Damian Wayne, his father and friends mourn him, despite their continued commitment to fighting crime.

batman-troika-reading-order.text: Bruce Wayne finally returns for good, wearing a sturdier Batsuit and driving a new, state-of-the-art Batmobile. He fights Colonel Vega, KGBeast, and Dark Rider, in order to foil a plot to nuke Gotham City.

batman-war-crimes-reading-order.text: The aftermath of War Games. Batman takes retribution against those responsible for the gang war. Stephanie Brown’s death is brought to the public’s attention, revealing that she was Robin.

batman-war-games-reading-order.text: Batman fires Stephanie Brown as Robin for disobeying orders. To prove her usefulness, she steals one of his contingency plans to put Matches Malone in charge of the Gotham Underground. However, most of the city’s gang leaders die in a shoot-out at the meeting she organizes. This power vacuum plunges the city into a violent gang war.

batman-zero-year-reading-order.text: Bruce Wayne returns to Gotham City after being away for so long that he has been declared dead. He dons a disguise and fights Red Hood One, and discovers he has much to learn if he wants to fight the new breed of costumed criminals plaguing Gotham.

battle-for-the-cowl-reading-order.text: Batman is dead. In the ensuing power vacuum Gotham begins to descend into chaos. Who will take up the Mantle of the Bat?

behold-the-millennium-giants-reading-ord.text: A trio of colossal Giants are out to remake the world and it is up to Superman and friends to stop them.

bloodlines-reading-order.text: Alien parasites have come to Earth with the intention of feeding themselves on human spinal fluids. Although the monsters slaughtered many, their feeding also activated the metagene in a number of individuals, leading to a massive wave of new super-powered characters, calling themselves “New Bloods”.

brightest-day-reading-order.text: At the climax of Blackest Night a number of deceased heroes and villains were returned to life by the Entity. Now the resurrected search to understand the Entity’s reasons for bringing them back, and to deal with other consequences of their returns.

brotherhood-of-the-fist-reading-order.text: An order of martial artists called The Brotherhood of the Fist declares war on Green Arrow, Nightwing, and every other master hand-to-hand combatant in the world.

bruce-wayne-fugitive-reading-order.text: Free from jail and now a fugitive, Batman abandons his Bruce Wayne alter ego to live only as Batman. Batman and the rest of the Bat Family continue their investigation into the murder of Vesper Fairchild.

bruce-wayne-murderer-reading-order.text: Bruce Wayne finds his girlfriend, Vesper Fairchild, dead in Wayne Manor just as police arrive. The Gotham City Police Department promptly charges Wayne for murder, and both Wayne and his bodyguard Sasha Bordeaux are imprisoned, leaving the Bat Family to work the crime and absolve them.

city-of-bane-reading-order.text: Bane's minions have moved into Gotham City, taken control and are ruling with an iron fist, including rounding up any villain who refuses to sign onto Bane's program, and Batman is nowhere to be found. At least not the Batman anyone knows. It's like someone has replaced the real Gotham City with a twisted funhouse-mirror version of it.

convergence-reading-order.text: Brainiac has been collecting cities and inhabitants from various timelines that have ended, trapping them in domes on a planet outside of time and space and opening them up to see what happens.

crisis-on-infinite-earths-reading-order.text: The Crisis on Infinite Earths was a Multiversal catastrophe that resulted in the destruction of countless parallel universes, and the recreation of a single universe.

dark-crisis-on-infinite-earths-reading-o.text: The Justice League are dead. The remaining heroes are left to protect the world from an onslaught of violent attacks by DC’s greatest villains! Leading the charge is a super-powered Slade Wilson...but this time there’s something dark fueling his rage.

dark-nights-death-metal-reading-order.text: Earth has been conquered by the Batman Who Laughs and Perpetua. The bad guys won, the good guys lost. And the Earth is suffering.

darkseid-war-reading-order.text: Two of the deadliest villains of the DC Multiverse, Darkseid and the Anti-Monitor, declare war on each other, with the Justice League caught in the crossfire.

day-of-judgment-reading-order.text: The Spectre goes on a rampage and begins destroying New York City, after he is forcibly bonded to the fallen Angel Asmodel by Etrigan. Asmodel, with the Spectre’s powers, freezes hell over, unleashing demons and the formerly damned souls upon the Earth again.

dc-k-o-reading-order.text: Various heroes and villains compete in a tournament so that the winner can obtain enough energy to confront Darkseid, who has returned to the DC Universe after creating and absorbing power from the Absolute Universe.

dc-one-million-reading-order.text: In the 853rd Century the original Superman still lives, but has spent over fifteen thousand years in a self-imposed exile in his Fortress of Solitude in the heart of the sun. Superman announces that he will soon return to humanity, and to celebrate, Justice Legion Alpha travels back in time to the late 20th century to meet Superman’s original teammates in the JLA.

dc-universe-trinity-reading-order.text: The Green Lantern Corps, L.E.G.I.O.N., and the Darkstars converge on the planet Maltus, birthplace of the Guardians of the Universe, the Controllers, and the Zamarons. They go up against a trio of cosmic powered ancient Malthusian Gods called The Triarch.

dc-you-reading-order.text: Welcome to the DC You Reading Order. Following the Convergence event the New 52 branding was dropped from all DC comics and was replaced by the DC You branding. DC You begins after the Convergence event and ends with DC Rebirth.

dceased-reading-order.text: Fighting time, each other and all of humanity, Earth’s greatest heroes must rally together for what may very well be their last chance to save the world from the most terrible plague humanity has ever seen.

death-of-superman-reading-order.text: Doomsday is here. Superman engages in battle with a seemingly unstoppable killing machine named Doomsday in the streets of Metropolis.

death-of-the-family-reading-order.text: The Joker returns to Gotham City after a year, appearing at GCPD Headquarters. He slaughters several cops and taunts Jim Gordon, then steals his own severed face out of the evidence room and leaves. Batman alerts the extended Bat Family that Joker has returned.

drowned-earth-reading-order.text: An armada from the stars has come to plunder the Earth and its seas. With powers beyond comprehension, even the Justice League’s combined might can’t stop these invaders. With nowhere left to turn, the heroes will have to turn to an ancient power to help them, one that even Aquaman fears unleashing.

eclipso-the-darkness-within-reading-orde.text: From his palace on Earth’s moon Eclipso uses hate as a trigger to possess other beings. Whenever someone who has a black diamond in their possession gets angry, Eclipso can instantly take control of that particular person.

endless-winter-reading-order.text: The Justice League encounters an extinction-level global storm brewing at the former site of the Fortress of Solitude.

event-leviathan-reading-order.text: A newly dangerous and aggressive Leviathan wipes out all its competition and now turns its sights to molding the world into its vision of order. Can the new threat’s growth be stopped and who’s guiding its new agents of chaos?

fear-state-reading-order.text: Gotham City is on the brink of a violent evolutionary path. The Magistrate now has full support from the mayor to handle high-level law enforcement in Gotham and has branded the Dark Knight public enemy number one. Batman must also contend with the return of the Scarecrow, who pursues his own terrifying agenda.

final-crisis-reading-order.text: Following the final battle of the New Gods, the spirit of Darkseid tumbles through time itself, coming to rest on Earth. Darkseid’s “fall” has sundered reality, creating a singularity at the heart of creation, into which all of space and time are slowly being drawn, setting the stage for the evil god’s final victory, to be claimed in his inevitable death.

final-days-of-superman-reading-order.text: Superman has come to the grim realization that he is dying. His exposure to the fire pits of Apokolips, the A.R.G.U.S. Kryptonite vault and Rao’s energies have all caused irreparable damage to his cellular structure. With time short, he reaches out to unite his friends and loved ones for what comes next.

final-night-reading-order.text: An alien named Dusk has crash-landed in Metropolis’ West River to warn the planet of the coming of an entity known as a Sun-Eater. As its name implies, this artificially created black hole is en route to Earth to literally consume Earth’s sun.

flash-dead-heat-reading-order.text: Savitar attempts to take control of the Speed Force, an indefinable energy field that is the source of all speedsters’ powers. Learning that every one of his allies, including Impulse and Jesse Quick, have lost their speed, the Flash rushes to take on this new menace.

flashpoint-reading-order.text: Barry Allen wakes up to discover everything and everyone around him has changed. The Flash, the Justice League, and even Superman do not exist. Barry realizes that the world of Flashpoint is not a parallel dimension, but an alternate reality and he must reset the timeline.

forever-evil-blight-reading-order.text: John Constantine, Swamp Thing, Nightmare Nurse, Pandora, and the Phantom Stranger attempt to defeat Blight, who is the manifestation of evil itself, and rescue the missing members of the Justice Leagues.

forever-evil-reading-order.text: With the three Justice League teams “dead,” the Crime Syndicate come from Earth-3 to take over this world, where they recruit villains to their cause. Prime Earth villains that resist follow Lex Luthor to form the Injustice League to take down the Crime Syndicate.

funeral-for-a-friend-reading-order.text: The funeral for Superman is attended by fellow heroes and friends, including most of the Justice League of America, and a mausoleum is built in Metropolis in honor of the Man of Steel. Every hero sports a black arm band featuring the S-Shield logo in remembrance.

future-state-reading-order.text: Future State is a possible future that showcases the legacy of the heroes of the Justice League in the near future.

genesis-reading-order.text: The “Godwave”, an interstellar phenomenon that, on its first pass, created gods on various planets through the universe. The Godwave then reached the edge of the universe and bounced back, creating superhumans on its second pass. Now the wave threatens reality when it rebounds back to its starting point on its third pass.

gothtopia-reading-order.text: Gotham City is and always has been a crime-free utopia, where the heroes are celebrated through the streets of one of America’s best cities. Batman is a universally beloved vigilante clad in white. His sidekick is Selina Kyle, otherwise known as Catbird. Who is behind this alternate version of Gotham?

grant-morrisons-batman-reading-order.text: Morrison began writing Batman in 2006 with issue #655, introducing the character of Damian Wayne and beginning a seven-year-long run on the character across multiple titles. This run is one of the most highly regarded Batman runs in history.

green-lantern-godhead-reading-order.text: The New Gods war with the Lantern Corps in search for a power to defeat Darkseid. Highfather learns that ring-wielders stole secrets from beyond the Source Wall. Highfather wants to do the same but first he needs his own set of rings.

green-lantern-lights-out-reading-order.text: Relic, a being from another universe, aims to destroy the emotional spectrum of the Lantern Corps. The lights of the Lanterns are fading as the emotional spectrum is being drained.

green-lantern-uprising-reading-order.text: The Durlans, a shape-shifting race of aliens, have infiltrated the ranks of the Green Lantern Corps and, through manipulation, have turned much of the universe against the Corp.

heroes-in-crisis-reading-order.text: Sanctuary is a secret rehabilitation center for superheroes and reformed supervillians dealing with mental health issues. After a horrible massacre claims the lives of nearly all its patients it is up to the survivors to find out who did it.

identity-crisis-reading-order.text: Sue Dibny, wife of the Elongated Man, is murdered, her body horribly burned. The super-hero community rallies to find the murderer.

injustice-reading-order.text: A tragedy perpetrated by the Joker leaves Superman devastated. Superman decides that it is time to put an end to all crime once and for all, establishing a unified world government named the One Earth Regime, which he leads as its High Councillor. Batman establishes an insurgency against his regime, and a war breaks out between the two factions.

invasion-reading-order.text: The Alien Alliance, led by the war-like Dominators and Khunds, intend on wiping out humanity to destroy all of Earth’s metahumans. This all-out assault on superheroes leads to a war consuming the entire world, and ramifications throughout the universe.

jack-kirbys-fourth-world-reading-order.text: The Fourth World is a science-fiction based mythology revolving around ancient space deities known as the New Gods. Similar to the gods of Earth lore, the New Gods are larger than life, possessing fantastic powers, which they use in a never-ending struggle between good and evil.

janus-directive-reading-order.text: Various metahuman military agencies in the U.S. receive intel called the “Janus Directive.” It details how each of the other agencies are plotting against them. Someone is manipulating the various agencies in order to distract them.

joker-war-reading-order.text: The Clown Prince of Crime battles the Dark Knight head-to-head for the last time. The Joker has never wanted to win before, he’s never wanted his battle with Batman to end, but now his motivation has shifted.

jokers-last-laugh-reading-order.text: While locked up in the Slab penitentiary, the Joker finds out he is suffering from a terminal brain tumor. Determined to go out with a bang, he uses a venom to “jokerize” other inmates, making them insane and changing their appearance, giving them white skin, green hair, and a wide smile.

jsa-black-reign-reading-order.text: Black Adam delivers his brand of liberation to the country of Kahndaq, while Hawkman plays an important role in leading the JSA into a battle staged in the Middle East.

justice-league-breakdowns-reading-order.text: A series of events hammer the Justice League, from assassinations to coup attempts. Will the Justice League be able to handle it?

justice-league-vs-suicide-squad-reading-.text: Following the discovery of Task Force X, the Justice League aims to shut the team down. Meanwhile other forces move against both teams.

knight-terrors-reading-order.text: When Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman find the body of one of their earliest enemies inside the Hall of Justice, their investigation takes them past the land of the living, beyond the land of the dead, and directly to a new villain called Insomnia...who uses his powers to engulf every single hero and villain in their own dark and twisted nightmares.

knightfall-saga-reading-order.text: Bane frees all of the inmates of Arkham Asylum. Bane’s plan is to weaken Batman by forcing him to deal with the deadly villains one at a time. Batman becomes weaker and weaker as each criminal is put away. After the Joker and Scarecrow take Batman to his mental and physical limits Bane makes his move and attacks Batman.

krypton-returns-reading-order.text: H’El has returned to Krypton’s past in order to change history. H’El has conquered Krypton and enslaved the population. Superman realizes that the only to end H’El’s plans is stop them from happening in the first place.

lazarus-contract-reading-order.text: When Deathstroke discovers that Wally West’s return holds the key to bringing his son back from the dead, he’ll stop at nothing to do just that.

lazarus-planet-reading-order.text: A volcano on Lazarus Island erupts, causing global magic storms that both give superpowers and alter existing ones.

legends-reading-order.text: Darkseid wants to destabilize Earth’s power structure so he can harvest the Anti-Life Equation. He decides that humanity will be easier to control if he destroys the legends that inspire them.

lightning-saga-reading-order.text: The JSA and JLA decide to team up and search for the time-displaced Legion of Super-Heroes members.

millennium-reading-order.text: Aliens visit Earth to start the next wave of human evolution. Ten humans are chosen to advance and become immortals, given special powers. They are attacked by Manhunter agents, part of an alien conspiracy posing as close friends and relatives to every single superhero.

multiversity-reading-order.text: The Multiverse is being invaded by malevolent destroyers known as The Gentry, who serve an entity only known as the Empty Hand. Various heroes from across the Multiverse are forced to band together to face this inter-dimensional threat.

new-52-futures-end-reading-order.text: Prime Earth is feeling the after effects of a war across the multiverse. As a new threat approaches the vulnerable Earth, Batman Beyond travels back in time to help the heroes of Prime Earth fend off the impending apocalypse.

new-52-reading-order.text: Welcome to the New 52 Reading Order. This is a reading order for all DC comics published under the New 52 line, beginning after the Flashpoint event and ending with the Convergence event. The continuity of the New 52 continues in the DC You Reading Order.

night-of-the-monster-men-reading-order.text: As a huge storm approaches, Batman, Batwoman, and Nightwing try and prepare Gotham City for the worst, but nothing can prepare the heroes for the enormous monsters rampaging through the streets.

night-of-the-owls-reading-order.text: Batman and his allies fight against the Court of Owls organization as they attempt to cement their control over Gotham City, which they have been manipulating in secret for centuries.

our-worlds-at-war-reading-order.text: Imperiex, an embodiment of entropy, detects imperfections in the fabric of the universe, and plans to destroy it and create a new, perfect universe. He heads to Earth in order to destroy it and induce a new Big Bang.

panic-in-the-sky-reading-order.text: Brainiac seizes control of Warworld. He then brainwashes Supergirl and the alien warrior Draaga before capturing Metron and setting off for Earth. Superman gathers a coalition of superheroes and launches a preemptive strike at Warworld before it can arrive on Earth.

red-daughter-of-krypton-reading-order.text: Kara is done with people pushing her around, taking advantage of her and betraying her. She’s done feeling helpless, lost, and discarded. She’s done with hope, faith, and acceptance. Now all that’s left is rage.

reign-of-doomsday-reading-order.text: A set of Doomsdays, each with the powers and abilities of Steel, Superboy, Eradicator, and the Cyborg Superman, are sent out to find and capture the four super beings who bore the S-Shield after Superman’s death.

reign-of-the-supermen-reading-order.text: Four new heroes emerge, each claiming in some way to be Superman.

rise-of-the-third-army-reading-order.text: Feeling that the Green Lantern Corps are fundamentally flawed due to free will, the Guardians of the Universe aim to replace the Green Lanterns with their new universal solution, the Third Army, as well as wiping out all other Lantern Corps.

robin-rises-reading-order.text: With the aid of his allies in the Justice League, Batman must wage war against the forces of Apokolips over the fate of his deceased son and former Robin, Damian Wayne.

robin-war-reading-order.text: Year Published : 2016 Featured Characters : Robin, Court of Owls Previous Event : Superman: Savage Dawn Next Event : Darkseid War

rotworld-reading-order.text: Swamp Thing and Animal Man emerge from the Rot one year into the future, to find that the Rot has overrun the planet, and overtaken any and everyone save those who have a connection to the Red or the Green. They try to make their way to face Anton Arcane and reverse the Rot’s effects.

shadow-war-reading-order.text: Year Published : 2022 Featured Characters : Batman, Bat Family, Deathstroke Previous Event : Trial of the Amazons Next Event : Dark Crisis on Infinite Earths

sinestro-corps-war-reading-order.text: The Green Lantern Corps fight an interstellar war against the Sinestro Corps, an army led by the former Green Lantern Sinestro who are armed with yellow power rings and seek a universe ruled through fear.

superman-doomed-reading-order.text: Doomsday has emerged from the Phantom Zone, wreaking havoc across the world. Superman kills the beast but is infected with a virus present in its blood. This causes Superman to mutate into a Doomsday-like creature.

superman-emperor-joker-reading-order.text: The Joker steals Mister Mxyzptlk’s reality-altering capabilities and remakes the entire world into a twisted caricature, with everyone in it stuck in a loop. The Joker tortures and kills Batman every day, only to bring him back to life and do it over and over again.

superman-exile-reading-order.text: Guilt drives Superman into space, where he hopes to forge a new life for himself away from Earth, and thus never be forced to hurt anyone again. During his space travels Superman discovers both new and old foes, and reconsiders his choices.

superman-hel-on-earth-reading-order.text: A figure from Krypton’s past has come to Earth, hoping to revive the dead planet in place of this one. Superman, Superboy, Supergirl, and the Justice League stand ready to fight, but whose side is everyone on? As hero fights against hero, will the Kryptonians be able to defeat H’El, who is their equal in every way?

superman-new-krypton-reading-order.text: The city of Kandor now resides near the Fortress of Solitude in the North Pole, populated by 100,000 Kryptonians. Superman attempts to aid the Kryptonians in their assimilation with the rest of the Earth, something very few Kryptonians seem interested in, including the city’s leaders.

superman-reborn-reading-order.text: Everything is perfect for Superman. He has a loving wife, a son he loves more than anything in the world and he’s once again Earth’s greatest hero. But there’s still one piece of the puzzle that doesn’t quite fit: Who is the man who’s calling himself Clark Kent.

superman-savage-dawn-reading-order.text: Superman and Vandal Savage have been on a collision course for centuries. As Kal-El struggles to survive against the barbarian’s attacking hordes, the events that led to Vandal Savage’s creation and his unexpected connection to Krypton are revealed.

superman-up-up-and-away-reading-order.text: Clark Kent is adjusting to a life without super-powers. He throws himself into his work and even manages to surpass Lois Lane as the Daily Planet’s star investigative reporter. Lex Luthor feels betrayed by the city he helped to build and embarks on a plan to destroy Metropolis.

the-black-diamond-probability-reading-or.text: Journey from the middle ages to present day to see the history of Eclipso’s Black Diamond.

the-culling-reading-order.text: With Superboy, the Teen Titans, and the members of the Legion of Super-Heroes who are trapped in the 21st century captured in N.O.W.H.E.R.E.’s base known as The Colony, N.O.W.H.E.R.E.’s leader Harvest pits the young heroes against each other, in an attempt to weed out the weak, and use the survivors in his elite guard known as Ravagers.

the-infected-reading-order.text: The Batman Who Laughs has been planning to make the Prime Universe as grim of a place as the Dark Multiverse from which he hails. His plans have included infecting heroes with a strain of the Joker Toxin that has turned them into corrupted versions of themselves, giving him new fearsome allies.

the-justice-society-returns-reading-orde.text: During World War II, Nazi sympathizers begin a ritual to ensure an Axis victory in the war. The spell goes wrong, however, and the Nazis release a villain known as Stalker, whose sole purpose is to end life everywhere. It is up to the Justice Society of America to stop him.

the-resurrection-of-ras-al-ghul-reading-.text: Ra’s al Ghul’s servant, the White Ghost, plans to bring his master back by transferring his mind to a new body. Talia teaches her son Damian about Ra’s, unaware that White Ghost plans to use Damian as a host body. Damian and Talia escape, while White Ghost is pushed into the Lazarus Pit holding Ra’s’ essence.

throne-of-atlantis-reading-order.text: When a US Navy missile drill goes wrong and strikes Atlantis with several missiles, their king Ocean Master takes it as a declaration of war and initiates war with the surface world. Giant tidal waves strike many coastal cities including Gotham City, Metropolis, and Boston.

titans-beast-world-reading-order.text: Year Published : 2023-2024 Featured Characters : Titans Previous Event : Gotham War Next Event : Superman: House of Brainiac

trial-of-the-amazons-reading-order.text: The three Amazonian tribes come together for the first time for a traditional Amazon contest. However a murder rocks Themyscira and leads to conflict.

trial-superman-reading-order.text: Weakened after a titanic battle with the Parasite, Superman inexplicably finds himself shackled and under arrest by a group of intergalactic officers. Taken to another galaxy, the Man of Steel has his powers negated and is instantly put on trial by an alien tribunal.

trinity-war-reading-order.text: Madame Xanadu has a vision of a conflict that will end with disaster. She shouts that she knows what “Trinity” is, and that they are coming. However, before she can warn anyone she is kidnapped.

underworld-unleashed-reading-order.text: Neron, the new ruler of Hell, gives villains their hearts desire in exchange for their souls. The villains overpower the heroes with their newfound power.

war-of-the-gods-reading-order.text: Ancient gods suddenly begin trying to destroy the Earth and each other. While the ancient Roman gods wage war with the Olympian gods, the Egyptian, African, Norse, Babylonian, and Thanagarian gods each want to recreate the world in their own images, and attack the superheroes who stand in their way.

war-of-the-green-lanterns-reading-order.text: Green Lanterns Hal Jordan, Guy Gardner, John Stewart, Kyle Rayner, Kilowog, and Guardian of the Universe Ganthet face off against their mind controlled fellow Green Lanterns and try to stop the renegade Guardian Krona from taking over the universe.

world-without-young-justice-reading-orde.text: Young Justice opponent Bedlam returns and once again recreats the world to suit his will. In this new reality, Young Justice consists of distorted, and in some cases amoral, parodies of their proper selves.

worlds-collide-reading-order.text: Fred Bentson unwittingly becomes a portal between two worlds and two cities. A living link between Dakota, home city of the Milestone heroes, and Metropolis, home of Superman. Eventually Bentson loses control of his powers and transforms into Rift. The heroes of the two universes come together to stop him and seal the dangerous rift between their worlds.

wrath-of-the-first-lantern-reading-order.text: The First Lantern is free and wants revenge for his years of imprisonment. He begins entering the minds and memories of the various beings present on Oa with the intention of examining their lives, to see how their life choices had changed them and altering events in order to see them suffer.

zatannas-search-reading-order.text: Zatanna attempts to reconnect with her father, Zatara, and seeks the aid of several heroes along the way.

zero-hour-reading-order.text: Parallax attempts to destroy the timestream so he can construct a better world, that won’t produce the evils that turned him into a villain. With the barriers of time destroyed, time begins eating away at itself from both ends, and the lines separating alternate timelines become blurred, allowing them to interact.
